title: Cloud partner weekly sync — prep & follow-ups (scratch)
content:
Context / goal:
- Weekly 1:1-style sync with cloud partner channel leads (rotate by region). Primary aim this week: unblock observability integration for Dedicated customers and firm up GA cadence for the new marketplace SKU pricing model. Secondary: align on co-marketing for April launch, confirm legal SOW questions.

Participants (tentative):
- Maya Thompson (me) — Partner PM (owner)
- Omar Patel — Solutions Eng (technical lead)
- Sofia Li — Rev Ops (billing/pricing)
- Ryan Chen — Channel Sales (EMEA)
- AWS: Priya (partner PM), Jason (channel eng)
- GCP: Lina (partner lead) — dialing in for billing sync
- Azure: optional attendee this week (catch-up on partner enablement)

Time: 45 minutes (agenda below). Prep notes to self: bring 2 slides (1) high-level integration timeline state diagram, (2) cost/sku mapping draft. Have quick answers ready for: "How will Dedicated customers see usage lines in their bill?" and "What is the SLA fallback if Dedicated region fails?"

Agenda (45m)
- 0:00–0:05 quick intros + objective reminder (Maya)
- 0:05–0:15 Observability integration status (Omar): logs/metrics ingestion, sample dashboards, open API contracts
- 0:15–0:25 Billing & SKU alignment (Sofia + GCP lead): finalizing marketplace SKU names, pricing rounding, taxonomy mapping for big customers
- 0:25–0:35 Go-to-market & co-marketing timing (Maya + Ryan): confirm joint webinar date, joint press timeline, assets needed
- 0:35–0:40 Legal/SOW open items (Maya): data residency clause, indemnity for third-party infra, audit log retention options
- 0:40–0:45 Recap + action items + owners (Maya)

Key talking points / data to surface:
- Observability: we need to ensure partner consoles can show token-level cost breakdowns for shared customers. Show draft of trace/span names we plan to emit (prefix: redwood.partner.*).
- Billing: propose 3 SKU buckets for marketplace: hosted-api, dedicated-reserved, private-onprem. Need partner confirmation on marketplace taxonomy before next Tuesday (2026-03-17).
- Pricing rounding: avoid sub-cent per-token; floor to $0.0001 increments. Sofia to present mapping.
- GTM: target joint webinar 2026-04-15, joint blog 2026-04-20. Need partner speaker and 2 customer case studies (ask channel to surface).

Open blockers (for meeting):
- Partner side: missing CloudPartner-AWS account mapping for a handful of early adopters (Priya to provide CSV).
- Legal: partner redline on audit frequency (they requested quarterly, our default 30 days).
- Tech: current KV cache telemetry does not include partner-tagged request IDs — Omar to propose minimal change for telemetry pipeline.

Draft questions to ask partners:
- Can you accept a two-tier SKU taxonomy (hosted vs dedicated) or do you require a more granular list?
- Will the marketplace surface our per-token metrics or only monthly invoice lines?
- For EU customers, is there a preferred KMS/HSM integration pattern we should support for Private deployments?

Action items (post-meeting follow-ups) — fill in owners/due dates during meeting:
- A1: Priya (AWS) to share account CSV for early adopters — due 2026-03-16
- A2: Omar to draft telemetry change (trace naming + partner tag) and PR -> ENG review — due 2026-03-19 (ENG-2490)
- A3: Sofia to publish final SKU mapping doc and sample invoice lines; sync with GCP finance lead — due 2026-03-17
- A4: Legal (Maya) to propose compromise on audit cadence and send to partner counsel — due 2026-03-18
- A5: Ryan to collect 2 customer case study candidates for joint webinar; follow up with EMEA reps — due 2026-03-24

Notes to self / rough email follow-up draft (send within 24h):
Subject: Thanks — follow-ups from today’s partner sync
Hi all,
Thanks for the productive sync. Attached are the three slides I promised (integration timeline, billing SKU draft, GTM calendar). Action items captured below; let me know if dates need to shift. Key ask: Priya, can you share the early-adopter account CSV by EOD Mon (Mar 16)?
Quick items we covered: observability tagging, SKU taxonomy, co-marketing dates.

Action items: (copy list A1–A5)

Thanks,
Maya

Slack pings to prepare before meeting:
- #partners: ping Omar + Sofia to review telemetry and SKU slide deck by Friday
- DM Priya: need CSV (include sample header: partner_account_id, redwood_customer_id, region, contact)

Evidence / attachments to attach in follow-up:
- integration-timeline-v2.pdf (one-pager)
- sku-mapping-draft.csv (sample invoice lines)
- proposed-webinar-outline.docx

Risks to watch (log in my notes):
- If partner delays SKU confirmation beyond 2026-03-17, marketplace publish slips 2 weeks -> impacts April co-marketing window.
- Billing taxonomy mismatch could cause month-end reconciling issues for large enterprise customers.

Back-of-envelope timeline (what I told product execs):
- Integration freeze (internal): 2026-03-31
- Marketplace submission window: 2026-04-01–2026-04-07
- Joint webinar: 2026-04-15
- Public GA: 2026-04-22 (soft rollout)

Reference tickets to bring up if asked:
- ENG-2413 (marketplace billing hooks)
- ENG-2490 (telemetry partner tags)
- PART-112 (partner onboarding checklist revision)

Random scratch ideas (brainstorm — don’t lead with these unless partner seems open):
- Offer a limited-time cross-credit program for early adopters (partner-funded credits to reduce friction)
- Create a single API proxy for partner customers to map marketplace SKUs to Redwood product SKUs automatically
- Light-weight partner dashboard (hosted) that surfaces cost anomalies and token spikes per customer

End notes (personal):
- Remind Omar to run a quick smoke test with the sample CSV before we ask partners to onboard customers.
- Keep email short — partners get >50 emails/week. Use bullets and explicit asks.
- Bring two margin scenarios for Sofia: conservative vs aggressive pricing impact (2 slides).

Last edit: added timeline and tightened action owners.
